method: Selected official vendor model/news histories, API changelogs and model lists, official service-status history, and selected serving-platform announcements. Search inventory is bounded; missing items are not proof that no announcement exists globally.
temporal_handling: Publisher/page dates, event impact times, actual checked time, planned availability, and page update dates are kept separate. UTC is preserved for Anthropic incidents; date-only publication pages have no inferred time or timezone.

selected_items.title: Two resolved Claude error incidents on Oct 25 UTC
selected_items.publication_timezone: UTC for incident updates and impact intervals as displayed
selected_items.finding: First incident impact 06:05–06:35 UTC, resolving update 07:53 UTC; investigating elevated errors for requests to Claude Mythos 5.1, Fable 5.1, Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5. Second Fable 5.1 incident impact 08:08–08:29 UTC, resolving update 08:49 UTC. Page showed All Systems Operational at check. This is service availability history, not model release.
limitations: Incident descriptions and current component status are provider-reported.
No independent uptime measurement was conducted.

selected_items.title: Ark catalog and release bulletin listing Kimi K3.1 Pro

limitations: Bulletin update date has no hour/timezone and cannot be ordered relative to the previous issue cutoff.
A page on a Beijing-region docs route does not establish availability in other regions.
No Ark per-token price or model-weight license was confirmed in checked sources.
The platform listing is not an independent model-quality evaluation.

scope_limits: This is not a census of all AI announcements.
No qualifying new major model announcement surfaced in the selected histories after the prior issue cutoff; the statement is limited to the listed pages.
Ark date-only release-bulletin update cannot be ordered relative to previous issue cutoff.
Anthropic incidents are provider-recorded service errors, not independently measured failures or model-quality changes.
Ark catalog route is Beijing-region documentation and does not establish global/other-region availability.
Prices, licenses, regional terms and weights not shown in checked pages are not inferred.
